biocontainers.name: tardis
biocontainers.summary: Pre-processor for bioinformatics cluster job submission

biotools.summary: TARDIS is an open-source R package for the automated integration and quality assessment of chromatographic peaks in targeted LC-MS metabolomics and lipidomics data. It provides a robust and scalable solution, validated across multiple biofluids and instruments.
